content.short: Bron is an MPC wallet for individuals and treasuries with biometric signing and guardian recovery.
content.description: Bron uses multi-party computation so no single device holds a complete key, with biometric signing and guardian-based recovery on top. Serving both individuals and treasuries from one product is unusual, since the approval workflows a team needs tend to get in a solo user's way.
content.meta: MPC key management with biometric signing and guardian recovery, for individuals and treasuries alike.
